fund_document_protocol.h_definition: industry values divided by mapped eligible equity value
fund_document_protocol.E_total_definition: all direct equity positions reported as EC or EP with Long payoff, including unmapped and intentionally fixed private/preferred equity; exclude fund shares and derivatives
fund_document_protocol.q_map_definition: mapped eligible equity value divided by NAV
fund_document_protocol.c_map_definition: E_map divided by E_total: reallocation coverage of all reported direct equity, not only a SIC-matching success rate
fund_document_protocol.fixed_assets: all assets outside the mapped eligible equity sleeve, including liabilities and net residual, remain fixed
fund_document_protocol.amendment_rule: for each series and reporting date, incorporate amendments publicly available before the cutoff; preserve original accession, selected accession and amendment chain. Later amendments are audit-only and are not retroactively substituted into inputs
fund_document_protocol.mapping_rule: verified issuer identity and source-dated SEC SIC mapped through French FF12 rules; mark as SEC-SIC proxy, not exact CRSP/Compustat industry replication
fund_document_protocol.replacement_rule: fixed order before evaluation-model outcomes; verify active mandate, development/A/C source completeness, eligible-position mapping completion and ultimate-parent independence from current official documents
fund_document_protocol.eligible_universe: SEC-registered publicly listed common equity and common-stock ADR whose issuer identity and source-dated SEC SIC can be verified; all other positions fixed with reason and amount
fund_document_protocol.mapping_completion_rule: reconcile every source position to a prespecified asset class; unresolved issuer/SIC linkage within the eligible universe blocks completion; do not reclassify linkage failures as excluded assets
fund_document_protocol.coverage_reporting: report c_map, q_total and q_map continuously for every period; no arbitrary minimum coverage ratio; claims apply only to mapped sleeve
fund_document_protocol.B_profile_usage: A/C context only; never translate holdings into B1 private signal or B2 optimal forecast
